```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
picks <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "picks")
roster <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "roster")
coaches <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "coaches")
# Coaches are counted over 2013 to 2025 seasons, and a producer is a coach whose
# draftee (last-school rule) is in a 2014 or later class.
window_label <- "2014 classes on"
tenure_window <- "2013 to 2025 seasons"
links <- coach_draftee_links(picks, roster, coaches, "last", 2014L)
producers <- unique(links$coach_id)
ten <- coach_tenure(coaches, producers, from = 2013L, to = 2025L)
tab <- ten |>
  group_by(tenure_bin) |>
  summarise(coaches = n(), producers = sum(produced), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(share = producers / coaches)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(tab, aes(100 * share, tenure_bin)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %d of %d coaches produced a draftee (%.0f%%)",
        tenure_bin, producers, coaches, 100 * share
      ),
      data_id = tenure_bin
    ),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * share)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 4.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "#374151"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    limits = c(0, 115)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of head coaches who produced a draftee, by seasons coached",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Head coaches in the window ",
      tenure_window,
      "; draftees from the ",
      window_label
    ),
    x = "Coaches with at least one draftee",
    y = "Seasons coached",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "coach-tenure-and-draftees", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-coach
ten_named <- ten |>
  left_join(distinct(coaches, coach_id, coach_name), by = "coach_id") |>
  mutate(
    tip =sprintf("%s: %d seasons, %s", coach_name, seasons, ifelse(produced, "produced a draftee", "no draftee"))
  )
p_coach <- ggplot(ten_named, aes(seasons, produced)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = coach_id, colour = produced),
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.12, width = 0, seed = 1),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "#9CA3AF"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("No draftee", "Produced a draftee")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 13, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Every head coach, by seasons coached",
    subtitle = "One point per coach, spread vertically to show overlap",
    x = "Seasons coached",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a point for the coach. Draftees are the last-school rule, 2014 classes on."
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_coach, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```
